basics.name: Mohamed Moustafa
basics.label: Senior Fullstack Engineer
basics.summary:
Web accessibility specialist and front-end-leaning full-stack engineer with 10+ years of experience in Vue and Ruby on Rails.

Served as a subject-matter expert for accessibility, bringing products to WCAG 2.1 AA compliance (EAA, AODA), led cross-functional design system teams, and grew and maintained component libraries.

Delivered end-to-end solutions for fast-paced SaaS companies, ranging from small startups to enterprises such as GitLab, thriving in autonomous remote/asynchronous environments.

As a Canadian-Egyptian, I bring a multicultural perspective that enhances collaboration across distributed teams.

work.name: Reaktor
work.summary: Reaktor is a digital consultancy that designs and builds strategic digital products and platforms for global clients.
highlights: Led frontend development and project management for a major European airline group's new in-flight Wi-Fi portal, delivering a streamlined experience to 10+ aircraft and 3,000+ passengers. Currently leading an upcoming high-profile partner integration.
Launched a strategic marketing campaign across 2 portal touchpoints for a major European airline group, generating new revenue while maintaining user satisfaction.
Delivered a new in-flight entertainment portal version for a leading Japanese airline's domestic flights. Upgraded deployments to support different versions per aircraft.
Modernized a leading Japanese airline's development infrastructure and managed Heroku PostgreSQL upgrades, improving security and reliability and reducing lead time for changes.

work.name: GitLab
work.summary: GitLab is a DevOps platform that provides a single application for the entire software development lifecycle.
highlights: Directed 7-person cross-functional project to enable purchasing and provisioning of the new Duo Enterprise AI offering, driving 10k+ user sign-ups. Used Vue.js, Ruby on Rails, GraphQL, PostgreSQL.

Introduced and optimized Duo AI add-on UI workflows and API endpoints for status tracking and bulk seat management, enabling 100k+ user sign-ups for the newly launched offering. Used Vue.js, Rails, GraphQL.
Championing accessibility initiatives as part of internal Accessibility Working Group, aligning Customers Portal with WCAG 2.1 AA standard.

work.name: Vidyard
work.summary: Vidyard is a video platform used by businesses for creating, sharing, and tracking video content.
highlights: Led UI design system working group, governing future goals and maintainership with 6 team members.
Maintained UI component library across all frontend services using Vue.js, ensuring consistent cross-platform user experience.
Adapted design system and component library to meet WCAG 2.0 AA accessibility standards, achieving AODA compliance for wider accessibility.
Integrated standalone microservice into application architecture, ensuring consistent deployment and scalability. Used Docker, Kubernetes, OAuth.
